subject: E-3159: cannot write data directory on Android
body:
Hi, I'm using MeshMail 2.8.5 on Android 15 (Pixel 8). Starting last week, the moment I save my work a dialog reads "E-3159: cannot write to data directory".

There is less than a gigabyte free on the system drive. Other applications also warn about low disk space now.

What I tried so far: waiting a day. No luck.

Aisha Bello -- Brightwater Clinics. Appreciate any pointers.
